title: Glo Class Completion Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glo:class completion_pct=*
| stats sum(completion_pct) as total_value, avg(completion_pct) as avg_value by style
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks style values by total and average completion percent across Glo class events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `completion_pct` values for each Glo class event and review total and average completion percent by style.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total completion percent.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which style shows the biggest completion percent numbers in your Glo class data.
